_help: Pa a Pa Caribbean: partner links. Nothing is shown until an entry has "active": true AND an https "url" (your own affiliate link from the partner's program). To add a partner, copy the example entry below into "partners", fill it in, and set active to true. "countries" holds country codes (JM, TT, DO...) or "*" for all. The "text" and "cta" objects hold one line per language (en, es, fr, nl); a missing language falls back to English.
